target.title: fix(agents): thinking-enabled Anthropic sessions fail with "Invalid signature" after tool loops
target.body:
Closes #99382

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where extended-thinking Anthropic sessions would fail with a 400 `Invalid signature in thinking block` and abort the turn after longer tool-use loops, with no compaction involved. The affected surface is Anthropic native message replay — both the SDK converter and the transport converter.

## Why This Change Was Made

Anthropic ignores past-turn thinking blocks for generation but still validates their signatures. With thinking enabled, both converters replayed every signed thinking block from completed turns, so any divergence between the reconstructed history and what the provider originally signed was rejected.

This scopes thinking replay instead of replaying unconditionally:

- `fable5` contracts keep full replay (unchanged).
- Thinking-enabled non-`fable5` models replay only the current turn — messages at or after the latest user message, plus the active tool-use turn whose thinking Anthropic requires for continuation.
- Thinking-disabled requests keep the existing tool-turn-only behavior.

Past-turn thinking is dropped before the payload is built, with one structured diagnostic per request for observability. Non-goal: this does not change compaction handling; the boundaryless-compaction path is #98527.

## Related PR Matrix

- #99383: canonical no-compaction completed-turn native Anthropic replay-policy fix. This PR owns the SDK and managed transport request builders.
- #94649: complementary recovery-side terminal-result handling; not a create-side replay prevention replacement.
- #100149: broader session-history sanitizer candidate; it changes more signed-thinking surfaces and currently has a ClawSweeper P1 replay-safe tool ID preservation blocker.
- #95819: Bedrock sibling fix; not the native Anthropic path fixed here.
- #94493 / #98831 / #99437: closed or partial-overlap attempts in the same signed-thinking replay cluster, superseded here by the scoped helper plus live proof.

## User Impact

Extended-thinking Anthropic sessions continue past longer tool loops without Invalid-signature rejections. No behavior change for `fable5` replay, thinking-disabled requests, or the in-flight tool-use turn.

## Evidence

- AI-assisted: implemented with an AI coding agent. I reviewed the code, tests, and final diff and understand the change.
- New targeted tests (SDK + transport converters): completed-turn thinking is dropped when thinking is enabled on non-`fable5` models, the in-flight parallel tool-use turn's thinking is preserved, and `fable5` still replays full thinking.
- Rebased refresh on PR head `b9a6d2829ec1fd9cb9a90ee9ef8c584b3af0a64e` (2026-07-05):
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts` — 47 tests passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts` — 89 tests passed.
  - `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic-thinking-replay.ts packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts` — passed.
  - `pnpm tsgo:core` — passed.
  - Refresh only adapted the PR to the current `main` package layout and logging host boundary; replay behavior and live-proofed scenario are unchanged.
- Earlier branch checks before the rebase refresh:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts src/llm/providers/anthropic.test.ts` — 40 tests passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts` — 84 tests passed.
  - `oxlint` reported 0 warnings / 0 errors on the changed files.
  - `pnpm build` succeeded.

## Live Anthropic Provider Proof

Live Anthropic provider proof on earlier PR head `aa76f779da88e17d34d7ae3826ba218b4e71b413` (2026-07-03 16:30 KST):

- Model: `claude-sonnet-4-6`; thinking enabled; scenario: completed prior assistant tool-use turn with a stale signed thinking block, followed by a later user turn.
- Raw provider replay with the completed-turn thinking block was rejected by Anthropic with HTTP 400: `messages.1.content.0: Invalid \`signature\` in \`thinking\` block`.
- Same transcript through this PR's OpenClaw converter logged `[anthropic-replay] dropped past-turn thinking blocks: count=1 assistantTurns=1 scope=current-turn model=claude-sonnet-4-6`, preserved the prior `tool_use`, and completed with HTTP 200 / `stopReason=stop` / assistant text `OK.`.
- Redacted payload summary: `thinking=0`, `toolUse=1`, `assistantMessages=2`, `completedTurnThinkingDropped=true`, `activeToolUsePreserved=true`.
